final: SELECT s1.link_to_event, s1.avg_ratio, CASE WHEN s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s1.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL THEN s1.avg_ratio / s2.overall_avg ELSE NULL END AS normalized_ratio FROM (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(CASE WHEN amount != 0 AND amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(spent AS REAL) / amount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_ratio FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event) s1, (SELECT AVG(event_avg) AS overall_avg FROM (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN amount != 0 AND amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(spent AS REAL) / amount ELSE NULL END) AS event_avg FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event)) s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY normalized_ratio IS NULL, normalized_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
